phase1.name: Phase 1: GMB Foundation & Core Signals (Days 1–10)
steps: Audit and lock in primary GMB category to 'plumbers' and add 4-6 relevant secondary categories.
Inject high-intent local keywords and geo-tags into business description and service menu.
Deploy automated post-service SMS review request campaign to past 60 days of satisfied customers.
Upload 15+ geotagged high-resolution photos of premises, staff, and real client work.

phase2.name: Phase 2: Local Authority & On-Page Dominance (Days 11–20)
steps: Build & sync consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) citations across top 40 local directories (Yelp, Apple Maps, Bing, YellowPages).
Inject LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema with exact geo-coordinates and service taxonomy on website.
Embed official Google Maps driving directions onto the website contact section.
Publish 2 weekly GMB updates with keyword-rich call-to-actions to keep profile freshness score high.

phase3.name: Phase 3: Automated Lead-Capture & 3-Pack Domination (Days 21–30)
steps: Install automated Missed-Call Text-Back: instantly texts callers within 30 seconds if staff is busy, locking in appointments.
Set up instant 24/7 web booking or inquiry capture workflow routing directly to front-desk phones.
Maintain steady velocity of 8-12 verified 5-star reviews every month to leapfrog competitor rankings.
Monitor Google Maps rank grid tracker to measure 3-pack expansion across target neighborhood radius.

coldEmail.subject: Protecting Beacon's #1 rank in Seattle
coldEmail.body:
Hi there,

Congrats on holding the #1 spot for plumbers in Seattle.

Staying there is the real challenge. I noticed your fresh review velocity has slowed down, and after-hours inquiries lack an automated 60-second follow-up workflow. In a market this competitive, slow response times quietly bleed high-ticket emergency calls to #2.

We help market leaders automate instant lead capture and sustain steady review flow so competitors can't close the gap.

Worth a quick 5-minute chat this week to see how it works?

Best,
Anuj
